repliche.sottotitolo: ZFS replication (Syncoid), native PVE replication, and replication through PBS when the storage is not ZFS. Protection backups to PBS are under {link}.
repliche.zfsSotto: ZFS send/receive between two PVE nodes
repliche.pveNativaSotto: vzdump + scp + qmrestore: any storage (full copy on every run)
repliche.viaPbsSotto: backup + restore on the destination node: best without ZFS (LVM, local, NFS…)
repliche.backupPbsSotto: protection and retention on PBS → open PBS backup
repliche.avvisoPbs: Backup → restore → VM registration on the destination node. Use it when source and destination do {non} share ZFS datasets (LVM-thin, local, NFS, Ceph…). With ZFS, prefer the {scheda} tab.
repliche.logPbsDett: Open the “Job history” tab under System logs for full details.
repliche.chiedeCompleta: “{nome}”: the last run asked for a FULL REPLICATION (the VM was migrated and shares no snapshot with the destination). Run it by recreating the destination from scratch? All disk data will be transferred.
repliche.erroreStato: Could not change the job state

jobModale.importPvesr: Importing from Proxmox replication {id}: fill in the destination ZFS storage and check the schedule. Disable the pvesr job on Proxmox before enabling the Syncoid replication, to avoid replicating twice.
jobModale.notaPveNative: {completa} mode (no bandwidth saving). For incremental replication between clusters use {viaPbs}.
jobModale.nessunaVm: No VMs found. Refresh or select another node.
jobModale.nessunDisco: No disks detected (the VM may not exist or may use an unsupported storage).
jobModale.isoEsclusi: ISO/CD-ROM and cloud-init disks are excluded from replication.
jobModale.datastoreVuoto: leave empty to use the PBS node's default datastore
jobModale.storageDestNota: Proxmox storage where the VM will be restored (ZFS, LVM-thin, dir, NFS, Ceph, …).
jobModale.storageRipristino: Restore storage (on the destination PVE node)
jobModale.storageRipristinoNota: When restoring through PBS the storage can be of any type (ZFS, LVM, dir, …).
jobModale.registrazioneAiuto: After every replication or backup-and-restore the VM is created on the destination node. The default is {attivo}.
jobModale.resync: After a VM migration, restart automatically with a full replication
jobModale.resyncNota: If the VM moves to another node the job follows it. After a {live} migration the disks share no snapshot with the destination: off (recommended), the run fails and asks for confirmation; on, it recreates the destination from scratch without asking.
jobModale.snapshotDaTenere: Snapshots to keep on the destination
jobModale.cartellaDumpNota: Must be writable and have enough free space.
jobModale.sovrascrivi: Overwrite the existing VM on the destination node
jobModale.sovrascriviNota: Required for scheduled replication (from the second run on): stop, destroy and recreate.
jobModale.rimuoviArchivio: Remove the archive on the source after the restore
jobModale.notaCompleta: {titolo} (vzdump + scp + qmrestore): everything is transferred again, with no bandwidth saving and no deltas. For incremental replication between clusters use “Replication through PBS”.
jobModale.nNever: No notifications, excluded from the summary
jobModale.suggNonZfs: At least one disk is not on a ZFS dataset: Syncoid cannot replicate it. Recommended: replication through PBS.
jobModale.suggTuttoZfs: All disks are on ZFS: for efficient incremental replication prefer Syncoid.
jobModale.suggPveNonZfs: Non-ZFS storage: native PVE replication copies everything on every run. Consider replication through PBS (incremental).
jobModale.selDisco: Select at least one replicable disk (ISO/CD-ROM excluded).
jobModale.selStorageZfs: Select the destination ZFS storage (or type it in).
jobModale.selStorageRipristino: Select the destination storage for the restore.
jobModale.discoNoZfs: Disk without a ZFS dataset: cannot be replicated with syncoid
jobModale.datiPersi: What you entered will be lost.

vm.sottotitolo: Resources, power state, snapshots and backups
vm.dalVivoAiuto: Reads the data from the nodes right now (slower)
vm.sanNota: {nota} automatic snapshots are handled by {cron} and {sanoid} at system level. The policies set here apply from the next scheduled runs (for example every 15 minutes or every hour).
vm.bkDisponibili: PBS backups available for this VM.
vm.bkNessuno: No backups found. Check the PBS configuration.
vm.wizSovrascrive: the restore overwrites existing data if the same VMID is used.
vm.wizNuovaVm: A new VM with ID {id} will be created.
vm.wizNuovoVmidNota: Leave empty to overwrite the existing VM.
vm.wizNomeNota: New name for the VM (only if you change the VMID).
vm.wizAvvia: Start the VM after the restore
vm.cloneAvviso: this creates a new VM by cloning the disks from the chosen snapshot. The original VM is not changed.
vm.idDrAttivo: DR activated: carries the source UUID
vm.idReplica: Replica: derived UUID, the source stays unique for Veeam
vm.idDrAiuto: Puts the source UUID back on this replica (does not start it)
vm.idDrNota: Use only when the source is lost. Does not start the VM.
vm.idVecchie: Replica of VM {vmid} registered under the old rules: it may have the same UUID as the source and start at boot enabled.
vm.idRiallineaNota: Writes the derived UUID and turns start at boot off. Only with the replica powered off; does not start it.
vm.ritFotoAssente: never saved: name and UUID are taken from the replica; bridge, start at boot and tags are not
vm.ritVerraMesso: will be set aside (renamed, not deleted)
vm.ritRipetere: “Prepare” can be repeated to shorten the final copy.
vm.ritPrepTesto: The current disk of the original is renamed, not deleted, and the replica’s data is copied to the source node with syncoid. Scheduled replication of this VM stays paused until completion.
vm.ritComplTesto: the service is down until the original responds. If it does not respond within the time below, the original is shut down and the replica started again.
vm.ritAttesa: Time to wait for the original to respond (seconds)
vm.drCosaFaTesto: writes the source VM’s SMBIOS UUID onto this replica, so systems that identify it by UUID (licences, Veeam, Windows) see it as the original.
vm.drCosaNonFaTesto: it does not start it. Starting remains a separate action.
vm.drVmgenidNota: (only if the VM is a domain controller and it is really needed)
vm.drForza: Force even if the source still appears to be running
vm.drForzaNota: (two VMs with the same UUID in the cluster)
vm.rf_interrotto: The service restarted midway: check which VM is running, then run “Prepare” again.
vm.rf_preparazione: Copying data to the source node. The replica stays on.
vm.rf_pronto: The data is on the source node: you can complete.
vm.rf_scambio: The replica is stopped: final copy and start of the original.
vm.ritAvviataPrepDett: The copy to the source node has started: the status updates by itself.
vm.ritAvviatoScambioDett: The replica is being shut down and the original started: the status updates by itself.
vm.confRollbackZfs: WARNING: destructive ZFS rollback to “{nome}” for dataset {dataset} (and the others). Confirm?
vm.confEliminaSnap: Delete snapshot “{nome}” from all disks of the VM? This cannot be undone.
vm.cloneServeVmid: A new VMID is required for the clone.
vm.confClone: Clone VM {da} to VM {a}? New disks will be created.

impostazioni.recupero: Catch up missed runs at startup
impostazioni.recuperoNota: If the service restarts after downtime, jobs that missed their last scheduled time start immediately, once (at most 4 replications run together). Off: they wait for the next scheduled time. Takes effect from the next service start.
impostazioni.riepilogoNota: Get a daily summary with the status of all jobs.

snapVm.sottotitolo: Scheduled native Proxmox snapshots with retention (label and number of copies). Several VMs per job, also selected by tag or node. Does not interfere with Sanoid/Syncoid.
snapVm.nessunaEsecuzione: No runs recorded for this job yet.
snapVm.riepilogo: Last run, snapshot {nome}: {ok}/{totale} VMs succeeded, {potati} snapshots pruned.
snapVm.vuoto: No snapshot jobs. Click {bottone} to schedule snapshots with retention on one or more VMs.
snapVm.confElimina: Delete job “{nome}”? Existing snapshots stay on the VMs.

snapJob.selettori: Dynamic selectors (new matching VMs join the job automatically)
snapJob.sparite: Some selected VMs no longer exist.
snapJob.scegli: Select VMs with the checkboxes or with the dynamic selectors.
snapJob.label: Label (snapshot class)
snapJob.ram: Include RAM (vmstate) for running qemu VMs
snapJob.ramNota: Recommended: off. With RAM the snapshot is slower and larger; LXC containers do not support vmstate (ignored for them).
snapJob.pvesrAiuto: This VM has active pvesr replication: a rollback redoes the replication (pvesr resyncs automatically after the rollback)
snapJob.processate: {n} VMs will be handled by this job.
snapJob.labelNota: Lowercase, letters and digits only (e.g. hourly, daily, weekly). Snapshot name: {nome}
snapJob.labelConflitto: Label already used by jobs: {job}. If the jobs share VMs, their retention rules will delete each other's snapshots.
snapJob.keepNota: On every run, {modello} snapshots beyond the {n} most recent copies are deleted. Manual snapshots and Sanoid snapshots are never touched.
snapJob.esempi: Examples: {a} every hour · {b} every night at 3 · {c} every Sunday.
snapJob.rPvesr: {n} VMs have active pvesr replication: snapshots coexist with it; only a rollback redoes the replication (pvesr resyncs automatically).
snapJob.rNota: The snapshots are native Proxmox ones: they also show in the Proxmox UI and can be restored from here with the job's “Snapshots” button. They do not interfere with Sanoid/Syncoid (prefix {a} ≠ {b}).
snapJob.serveEntrambi: To continue: fill in the job name and select at least one VM (or a selector)
snapJob.serveNome: To continue: fill in the job name
snapJob.serveVm: To continue: select at least one VM (or a selector)

pbsBackup.sottotitolo: VM protection on Proxmox Backup Server: scheduled jobs, inventory and restore
pbsBackup.jobNota: VM backup jobs to PBS (no automatic restore).
pbsBackup.logNota: PBS backup, restore and replication logs (last 50).
pbsBackup.vsNota: Here you manage backups to PBS (retention, schedule, alerts). To replicate VMs to another node when there is no ZFS, use {link}.

pbsInv.sottotitolo: VM and container backups already on Proxmox Backup Server (made by Proxmox, by dapx or manually)
pbsInv.esploraNota: Pick a machine to see its available backup dates, then choose a date and start the restore to a PVE node.
pbsInv.selNodo: Select a PBS node to see the inventory.
pbsInv.nessuno: No backups found. Check the datastore, PBS credentials and PBS storage on the PVE nodes.
pbsInv.sovrascrive: The restore overwrites the VM if the VMID already exists on the destination node.
pbsInv.cerca: Search by VMID or machine name…
pbsInv.pNota: Browse existing backups (from Proxmox, from dapx or manual). For automatic replication to another node use {link}.

hostBackup.sottotitolo: Configuration backup of Proxmox PVE and PBS hosts
hostBackup.coseNota: Backup of the Proxmox system configuration files (not of the VMs). Includes: /etc/pve, /etc/network, cluster configuration, SSH keys, cron jobs.
hostBackup.utile: Useful for: disaster recovery, server migrations, restoring the configuration.
hostBackup.nNever: No notifications, excluded from the summary
hostBackup.nessunJob: No jobs configured. Create one to get started.
hostBackup.nessunBackup: No backups found for this node.
hostBackup.selPerVedere: Select a node to see its backups.

fileDati.sottotitolo: Folder replication between NAS devices: direct rsync (data does not pass through the server) or rclone SMB, and replication to QNAP with WORM immutability (native snapshots). Endpoints are shared.
fileDati.nasNasSotto: direct rsync or rclone SMB between NAS devices
fileDati.wormSotto: sync to the QNAP staging share, with immutable snapshots
fileDati.nessuno: No jobs. Create an endpoint and a job (NAS→NAS or QNAP WORM) to get started.
fileDati.catAiuto: du scan over SSH for folder sizes and time estimates
fileDati.parziale: Some data could not be loaded: showing what is available.
fileDati.nessunEndpoint: No endpoints. Click {bottone} to register one.
fileDati.confCatalogo:
Refresh the du catalogue of “{nome}”?

Scans the source over SSH (first level) for folder sizes and time estimates. Does not start the copy.

fileJob.epOrigineFisso: The source endpoint cannot be changed when editing a job.
fileJob.epDestFisso: The destination endpoint cannot be changed when editing a job.
fileJob.shareNota: Choose only the destination QNAP share. Subfolders inherit the Synology path.
fileJob.shareAiuto: Select only the QNAP share (e.g. DATI). Subfolders inherit the Synology path.
fileJob.mirror: Delete from QNAP the files no longer on Synology (mirror; no source history)
fileJob.nNever: No notifications, excluded from the summary
fileJob.notNota: With the default setting no email is sent for this job: its runs appear in the daily summary, one email for the whole site. SMTP must be configured under Settings → Notifications.
fileJob.cartelleNota: Select the Synology folders. The share/folder structure is replicated under DATI on QNAP. {a}, {b}, {c} and system folders are always excluded from the sync (no history from the source).
fileJob.esclusioniNota: Automatic exclusions (cannot be turned off): {elenco}, recycle bins and system folders. History is configured only with QNAP snapshots.

endpoint.hostNota: It must be reachable from the dapx server, not just from your PC.
endpoint.portaQnap: QNAP: 8080 = HTTP, 443 = HTTPS (recommended if you reach the NAS over https).
endpoint.portaDsm: DSM API port (browse and test): 5001 = HTTPS, 5000 = HTTP. The rsync job over SSH uses port 22.
endpoint.https: Use HTTPS (port 443, or force HTTPS on a custom port)
endpoint.verifica: Verify the SSL certificate (turn off for a self-signed NAS certificate)
endpoint.nonCambiare: Leave empty to keep it unchanged
endpoint.servePassword: A password is required for a new endpoint
endpoint.primaSalva: Save the endpoint before testing the connection

sfoglia.selEndpoint: Select an endpoint to browse its folders.

fileLog.nessuno: No log available. If the job does not start, check rsync and sshpass on the server and SSH on the NAS devices.

qnap.nota: dapx replicates only the current files from Synology. Snapshot and system folders ({cartelle}, …) are never copied. History is managed only on QNAP, with Snapshot Manager.
qnap.p2: Snapshot schedule: at least one hour after the dapx sync.
qnap.p4: Retention: Smart Versioning or maximum number of snapshots (e.g. {n}).
qnap.p5: Enable “Only if modified” and guaranteed snapshot space.

nasJob.shareNota: Choose only the destination share. Subfolders inherit the source path.
nasJob.shareAiuto: Select only the destination share (e.g. DATI). Subfolders inherit the source path.
nasJob.nonDoppio: Do not schedule the same folders both here and in QNAP WORM replication: the two modules do not coordinate.
nasJob.mirror: Delete from the destination the files no longer in the source (mirror)
nasJob.sizeOnly: Compare file size only (rclone --size-only, no hash calculation)
nasJob.usaRsync: Direct rsync will be used: data does not pass through the dapx server.
nasJob.cartelleNota: Select the source folders. Their structure is replicated under the destination base path. {a}, {b}, {c} and system folders are always excluded from the sync (no history from the source).
nasJob.esclusioniNota: Automatic exclusions (cannot be turned off): {elenco}, recycle bins and system folders. History is configured only with the destination NAS's snapshots.
nasJob.rcloneNota: rclone uses {a} and {b} to reduce SMB calls on folders with many files.

nasEndpoint.ssh: SSH access (direct replication and du catalogue)
nasEndpoint.sshNota: Used by dapx to run rsync and du on the source.
nasEndpoint.rsync: rsync service (for the destination role, direct engine)
nasEndpoint.moduloNota: Name of the module configured on the NAS (DSM: File Services → rsync; QTS: Rsync Server).
